repos.name: aerial-tv
repos.description: 给国产电视的一块干净桌面：参照 tvOS 设计的开源 Android TV 桌面，没有广告，开机自动接管。A tvOS-style launcher for Xiaomi, TCL and other China-market TVs.
repos.readme_snippet:
Aerial
给国产电视的一块干净桌面。
参照 Apple TV 做的 Android TV 桌面：没有广告，没有推荐流，只有你的 App、壁纸和航拍屏保。
适合小米、TCL、创维、索尼等国产电视，也能装在盒子和投影仪上。开机自动进入，待机也不会被清理。
中文 · English

- 整理：长按 OK 键（或按菜单键）可以移动

repos.name: fairplay-decrypt
repos.description: Offline FairPlay App Store IPA decryption with independent key derivation
repos.readme_snippet:
IPA decryptor
Decrypt FairPlay-encrypted apps using a 16-byte credential
for the account that owns each IPA. Credential retrieval
gets it from a supported jailbroken device and writes
credential.bin to the chosen output directory.
Decryption runs on macOS and Linux.
Supports version-3 and version-5
